name: @hozo/example-storybook
description: Storybook, audited against axe-core in CI.

scripts.test: tsc --noEmit -p . && node scripts/build.mjs storybook-static-check && node scripts/check-build.mjs storybook-static-check && node scripts/check-a11y.mjs storybook-static-check && node scripts/check-utterances.mjs storybook-static-check
scripts.utterances:update: node scripts/build.mjs storybook-static-check && node scripts/check-utterances.mjs storybook-static-check --update
